_comment: Limits for bench/compare.py. Every gated metric is higher-is-worse. A metric FAILS only if BOTH limits given for it are exceeded: the increase over the baseline is more than max_increase_pct percent AND more than max_increase in absolute units (so a tiny metric near 0 is not failed by a large percentage of nothing). If only one limit is given, that one alone decides. Derived from three baseline invocations on one machine; see PERFORMANCE.md. cpu_ms and wall_ms are reported but not gated: cpu_ms counts every thread.
